integrity: Every all-node claim has an analytic argument; finite numerical checks supplement rather than prove asymptotics or universal quantifiers. The Möbius transform, Poisson-kernel identity and one-component exactness are prior knowledge; no independent audit is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Only zero-phase normalization on positive finite centered Cauchy mixtures; no arbitrary test-function, floating-point, shifted-grid or non-centered guarantee. Specialized publication-priority overlap remains possible.
title: Parity-sharp exactness and scale optimization for Cauchy-mixture Möbius trapezoids
